title: 第3章 本源洞天第4章 青石镇
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
凌啸风看着一旁快吃完饭的儿子，也有一些无奈。
儿子虽然年幼，但却一直很有主见。
平时乖巧无比，但当涉及到一些事情的时候，却很有自己的原则，就连他这个做父亲的都很难改变。
凌宇看着父母注视过来的目光，就知道他们在想什么，毕竟也不是第一次了。
就是想让他尽快进入秘境获取无主洞天，以便辅助自己修行。
这个世界的修行主要以炼气和炼体为主。
炼气修炼以修炼自身本源洞天为主，洞天越强大则自身实力越强大。
以法术、神通为主要护道手段，拳脚兵器为次要护道手段。
灵根资质合格者，都可以在中丹田位置以灵根为媒介唤启自己的本源洞天。
灵根资质越好则开启的本源洞天越大，法则也越完善，更像一个完整的小世界，洞天发展前景也越广。
本源洞天越完善，将来法则显现之后对自己未来修炼的帮助也就越大。
相反，资质越差，唤启的本源洞天也就越小，法则也越单一，更像一个发育不良的小世界，发展面就窄。
两者就像一个法则完善的五行洞天与一个法则单一的火属性洞天相比，自然五行洞天的发展前景更广，将来法则显现，谁对修炼者的帮助大，则一目了然。
在灵觉境一般人觉醒的本源洞天最大为方圆九丈大小。
刚进入灵觉境会根据自己灵根资质生成一个方圆一丈到九丈的虚幻洞天。
经过灵觉境前期、中期、后期、圆满虚幻洞天会逐渐化虚为实，成为一个真正的洞天。
炼体修炼则以修炼全身三百六十五个主要窍穴为主，以拳脚兵器为主要护道手段，却不能释放法术。
在开窍境打通第一个窍穴气海穴，然后将灵力储存在气海穴中，再以气海穴为灵力之源，打通其它窍穴，锤炼自身体魄。
这种修炼在凌宇看来更像是前世各种剧里提到的武道修行，而不是那种只修炼肉体的纯炼体者。
凌宇也问过自己老爹，结果凌啸风叫凌宇不要胡思乱想，这就是炼体修行，他是不会错的。

凌宇也就作罢，反正不影响自己修行。
至于同境界的炼体者与炼气者相比到底谁强谁弱，只能说跟自己本身有关，与道路无关。
凌宇现在的境界就是灵觉境后期，相当于手机充电时电量的百分之九十左右，而圆满则是电量到百分之百。
本源洞天在第五境灵虚境之前是无法自主接通天地从虚空中获取能量的。
修炼者死后本源洞天却会遁入归墟之地，一般低阶修炼者的本源洞天很快会被归墟之地的规则之力侵蚀瓦解，只有高阶修炼者的本源洞天才有抵抗归墟之地侵蚀的能力。
大能们经过研究，在第五境之前炼化一座可以自主汲取宇宙能量的本源洞天，可以加快低阶修炼者修行，但是也只能炼化一座。
content_en:
Ling Xiaofeng looked at his son who was almost finishing his meal and felt helpless.
Although my son is young, he has always been very independent.
He is usually very well-behaved, but when it comes to certain things, he has his own principles, which even a father would find difficult to change.
Ling Yu looked at his parents' gazes and knew what they were thinking. After all, it wasn't the first time.
I just want him to enter the secret realm as soon as possible to obtain the Masterless Cave Heaven to assist him in his cultivation.
The practice in this world mainly focuses on refining Qi and refining body.
Qi refining practice mainly focuses on cultivating one's own origin, the cave heaven. The stronger the cave heaven, the stronger one's own strength will be.
Spells and supernatural powers are used as the main means of protecting the way, and fists and weapons are the secondary means of protecting the way.
Those with qualified spiritual roots can use their spiritual roots as a medium to awaken their original cave in the middle Dantian position.
The better the spiritual root qualifications, the larger the original cave will be, the more perfect the rules will be, and it will be more like a complete small world, and the development prospects of the cave will be broader.
The more perfect the Origin Cave is, the greater it will be for your future cultivation after the laws are revealed.
On the contrary, the worse the qualifications, the smaller the origin cave that can be awakened, and the simpler the rules. It is more like a stunted small world, and the development scope is narrow.
The two are like a Five Elements Cave with perfect laws and a fire-attribute Cave with a single law. Naturally, the Five Elements Cave has a broader development prospect. In the future, when the laws are revealed, it will be clear which one will be of greatest help to cultivators.
In the realm of spiritual awakening, the maximum size of the source cave for ordinary people to awaken is nine feet in diameter.
When you first enter the realm of spiritual awareness, an illusory cave with a radius of one to nine feet will be generated based on your spiritual root qualifications.
After the early, middle, and late stages of spiritual awakening, the illusory cave will gradually turn into reality and become a real cave.
Physical training focuses on cultivating the 365 main acupoints on the body, and fists and feet weapons are used as the main means of protection, but spells cannot be released.
Open the first acupoint, the Qihai acupoint, in the orifice-opening state, and then store the spiritual power in the Qihai acupoint. Then use the Qihai acupoint as the source of spiritual power to open other acupoints to temper your body.
In Ling Yu's opinion, this kind of practice is more like the martial arts practice mentioned in various dramas in previous lives, rather than the kind of pure body training that only cultivates the physical body.
Ling Yu also asked his father, but Ling Xiaofeng told Ling Yu not to think nonsense. This was body training and he couldn't be wrong.
Ling Yu gave up because it wouldn't affect his practice anyway.
As for who is stronger and who is weaker among body refiners and qi refiners of the same realm, it can only be said that it has something to do with oneself and has nothing to do with the path.
Ling Yu's current state is the late stage of the spiritual awakening state, which is equivalent to about 90% of the battery when charging the mobile phone, and perfection is when the battery reaches 100%.
Before the fifth realm of spiritual void, the Origin Cave Heaven was unable to independently connect to the heaven and earth to obtain energy from the void.
After the death of a cultivator, the Origin Cave Heaven will escape into the Gui Xu Land. Generally, the Origin Cave Heaven of low-level cultivators will be quickly eroded and disintegrated by the power of the rules of the Gui Xu Land. Only the Origin Cave Heaven of high-level cultivators has the ability to resist the erosion of the Gui Xu Land.
After research, the powerful people refined an origin cave that can independently absorb the energy of the universe before the fifth realm, which can speed up the cultivation of low-level practitioners, but they can only refine one.
